dct_description_sm: The Ipsos Canada Winter 2004 RBC Housing Study analyzes home ownership trends in Canada.  Participants to the survey reveal key information on current home ownership status and short-term intentions, mortgage financing, values of property, as well as Canadians' RRSP contributions to their property.  This survey has a weighted sample of 2,000 respondents.  The study consists of statistical tables extracted from the original data, as well as reports and presentations.
